reason: The handler performs a live GitHub release lookup. Route tests are hermetic; the release mapping is unit-tested separately. Reviewed 2026-11-12.

A successful save requires a real encoder executable whose version stamp and --help output identify the selected family. The fork validation and probe-refusal paths are route-tested; the probe parser is unit-tested. Reviewed 2026-11-13.

A successful upgrade needs a bundled language server or a matching Pyright installation, neither of which is guaranteed in the hermetic route-test host. The route's upgrade refusal is tested and the availability route reports absence as a supported answer. Reviewed 2026-11-13.

A decoded frame needs a real decoder and a valid video fixture, neither of which is guaranteed in the hermetic route-test host. The missing-frame and unsupported-source refusals are route-tested, and the decoder is exercised by real-media tests where one is available. Reviewed 2026-11-13.

The 404 is a rollback path taken only when the project created by this same request disappears before its first video can be imported. Reaching it deterministically would require racing a concurrent delete, so the route's success and validation refusals are tested instead. Reviewed 2026-11-13.
